title: Infotainment Engineer
summary: Builds the software inside a car's dashboard screen, the head unit that runs media, phone, navigation and vehicle settings, usually on Android Automotive or Qt on embedded Linux. Works in an automotive software team below the app layer, on platform services, HALs (hardware abstraction layers) and Bluetooth and audio.
dailyDuties: Add features to AOSP framework services or Qt middleware
Integrate vehicle signals through the vehicle HAL
Debug Bluetooth phone and audio issues from HCI logs
Fix media playback and audio routing bugs
Bring up builds on new head-unit hardware
Review code in Gerrit and fix bench-test defects

skills.expectation: Build on Android Automotive OS: AOSP framework services, car APIs and HALs
Build infotainment HMI and middleware with Qt and QML on Linux or QNX
Write C++ for HALs, middleware or Qt apps
Write Java for Android framework services and system apps
Work on embedded Linux or Android BSP layers such as Yocto images and drivers
Integrate and debug Bluetooth phone, audio and contacts profiles such as HFP, A2DP, AVRCP and PBAP
Handle media playback and audio routing with GStreamer or the Android audio stack
Write multithreaded code that talks across processes over Binder, D-Bus or sockets
Build Android system apps with the SDK
Use Kotlin for newer Android system apps
Read vehicle signals that arrive over CAN
Know QNX or another RTOS used in clusters and head units
Work with Git, Gerrit and repo on AOSP-scale code
Build images and modules with CMake, Make or Soong

groups.label: An infotainment platform (Android Automotive or Qt/QML)
